title: Gupta Rule
note: Banglapedia entry by Aksadul Alam, summarizing inscriptional, coin, and literary evidence for Gupta expansion and regional states in Bengal. Its dating and identifications are sometimes explicitly qualified as probable.
whyItMatters: The entry supplies a separate reference account of Bengal's fourth-century regional states, Samatata, and Gupta expansion, while marking some identifications and dates as uncertain.
